    split = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 4 for v in row))
    upper = grid[:split]
    lower = grid[split + 1:]
    return [[3 if a == 2 or b == 1 else 0 for a, b in zip(top, bottom)]
            for top, bottom in zip(upper, lower)]
